parameters.query:
SELECT q.sent_last_24h, q.queued, q.ready_now, q.in_flight,
       q.needs_reconciliation, q.expired_leases, q.open_critical_alerts,
       q.emergency_stop, q.production_mode,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign.campaign_progress WHERE status = 'running') AS running_campaigns
  FROM campaign.queue_health q

parameters.subject: Campaign daily digest
parameters.message:
={{ 'Sent in the last 24h: ' + $json.sent_last_24h + '
Queued: ' + $json.queued + ' (' + $json.ready_now + ' ready now)
In flight: ' + $json.in_flight + '
Awaiting reconciliation: ' + $json.needs_reconciliation + '
Expired leases: ' + $json.expired_leases + '
Open critical alerts: ' + $json.open_critical_alerts + '
Running campaigns: ' + $json.running_campaigns + '

Emergency stop: ' + $json.emergency_stop + '
Production mode: ' + $json.production_mode }}
